item.title: Exploring movie similarities with vector search algorithms
item.description: I taught a thread on “find movies like this” that kept growing: embeddings in PostgreSQL, the same idea in Qdrant with two different vector meanings, then retrieval + a local LLM grounded on the same rows. This page is the story; notebooks and animations live in AlgoETS/SimilityVectorEmbedding.
